fact: The CAG's 2022/23 local government report states that PO-RALG's letter of 31 January 2023 ordered all councils to install and fully use the TAUSI revenue system by 31 March 2023, register all POS devices and stop collecting through LGRCIS, and that TZS 45.02 billion of debts in LGRCIS across 125 councils remained unresolved after the move.
title: Ripoti Kuu ya Ukaguzi wa Serikali za Mitaa kwa Mwaka wa Fedha 2022/23
